confirmed_mechanism: pool.Close cancels puddle baseAcquireCtx while a detached Gateway safety watch is constructing a pgx connection; connection.close/c.done and outer-handler return do not join the watch

confidence.mechanism: reproduced with real production watch/validator/pgxpool/pgx; normal and race controlled probes
confidence.exact_ci_fixture: unavailable: non-verbose hosted log, no local full PG/NATS environment

finding.behavior: A fixture may close its pool before every previously bound connection safety-watch goroutine has ended. The real connection-constructor cancellation is then intentionally rejected by watchTransportFailure and escapes through serve.func3 panic.
finding.classification: lifetime/ownership defect, not evidence that context.Canceled should be globally network-classified
finding.scope: outside current planning task: backend/** explicitly forbidden; no remaining correction proven within the two permitted workflow delta classes

hypotheses.name: fixture/pool teardown races detached watch acquisition
hypotheses.result: mechanism reproduced, including socket-retirement order; precise hosted fixture not uniquely identified

hypotheses.name: watch one-second timeout
hypotheses.result: control returns context.DeadlineExceeded, net.Error=true, classifier=true; differs from hosted context.Canceled

hypotheses.name: IPv4/IPv6/TLS fallback alone
hypotheses.result: single IPv4 reproduces same unknown first branch; TLS disable already active in hosted raw log

hypotheses.name: cross-package shared DB data corruption
hypotheses.result: no evidence; error is startup context cancellation, not PgError or changed data; full suite not locally reproduced

minimal_decision_question: 是否授权一个独立、窄 Go 生命周期修复切片：仅 Gateway 已启动 safety watch 的终止/完成所有权及直接相关测试 fixture 的关闭等待，保留原 classifier、未知/internal/mixed panic、契约/ACK/安全边界、全部 normal+race；不授权 GROUP 产品或 blanket backend 范围？
